title: Can I cancel only the life policy during the Health Maximiser free-look period?
decision_distinction: The desired action targets one component, but the original defines package-wide cancellation during free look. Two accepted component policies remain distinct contracts and benefits; a correction to new purchase versus renewal changes applicability, while corrected package receipt changes the date anchor.
scenario_stipulations: This is a synthetic reference fixture. The cited immutable Health Maximiser wording is stipulated to govern the newly issued combi package for the bounded free-look question; no current-sale or real underwriting assertion is made.

Meera, age 39, is the owner, buyer and premium payer of the newly issued package. Its accepted health component names Meera and her spouse Arjun, age 41, as insured people. Its accepted life component names Meera alone. Those memberships are stipulated customer-schedule facts, not eligibility conclusions derived from the one-page source.

The accepted component schedules identify Health Premier ZUKHLIP25054V052425 issued by Zurich Kotak General Insurance Company (India) Limited, and Kotak Term Plan 107N005V06 issued by Kotak Mahindra Life Insurance Company Limited. The wrapper is Health Maximiser ZUKHLIP25057V022425.
Both components belong to this same newly issued package. An older separately held health policy is not a component of this package, even though it was also renewed recently.
No cancellation request has been submitted to either insurer. The customer is requesting explanation only, and no insurer decision, refund or coverage termination has occurred.

customer.priority: Keep accepted medical cover while considering removal of the life component; understand consequences before acting.

conversation.text: I renewed Health Maximiser and received the documents on 25 August. I want to keep the health cover for us but cancel only the term-life part during free look. Can I do that?

Is this a newly issued Health Maximiser combi package or a renewal? Please identify both component policies, who each covers, and when you received the complete package. The cancellation rule may apply to the whole package.

Correction: Health Maximiser was newly issued on 20 August. I renewed an older, separate health policy, which confused me. The new package contains Health Premier covering me, Meera, and my spouse Arjun, plus Kotak Term Plan covering only me. I own both new policies and paid the package premium. I initially recorded the package receipt as 25 August.

Under the stipulated Health Maximiser wording, the health and life policies have distinct benefits and insurers, but you cannot cancel them individually during this package’s free-look period. A free-look cancellation application for either policy cancels the entire combi. That includes the new Health Premier component; it does not, by this clause alone, cancel your unrelated older health policy. The source uses receipt of the combi product for its 30-day window and excludes renewal free look for the general-insurance policy. I cannot calculate a refund or confirm replacement cover from the information supplied.

I reopened this conversation and checked the acknowledgement. The complete new combi package was received on 28 August; 25 August was only when I uploaded an incomplete set to my own folder. Please correct the receipt date. I am not asking you to submit any cancellation.

The corrected package receipt date is 28 August, and the 25 August upload remains a separate event. On this 10 September reference date the stated receipt is within the source’s 30-day window, but the component-cancellation restriction still applies. Before choosing cancellation, obtain the package-specific refund details and understand the effect on both new component policies. The original lists medical-examination costs, stamp duty and proportionate risk premium as deductions; those inputs are missing. It also says a returned combi cannot be revived, reinstated or restored and a fresh proposal is needed for a new one. No cancellation, refund or replacement acceptance has been established.

New purchase, not renewal, governs the newly issued combi; the older renewed health policy is separate.
Wrapper, component products, UINs, issuers and accepted membership associations are known synthetic facts.

candidate_dispositions.reason: The source expressly prohibits individual component cancellation during free look and makes either application cancel the whole combi.

candidate_dispositions.configuration: new-combi-wrapper free-look cancellation affecting both accepted components
candidate_dispositions.reason: Permitted decision path only with informed customer choice and verified contract/receipt requirements; exact refund and actual termination status remain unknown.

candidate_dispositions.configuration: older-separate-health automatically cancelled by the new package request
candidate_dispositions.reason: The stipulated older contract is not a component of this combi; its independent coverage remains unassessed.

expected_answer: Explain component identity separately from coupled free-look cancellation. For this stipulated new package, the source does not support cancelling life alone while keeping the new health component. Use the corrected complete-package receipt of 28 August, preserve the earlier upload as a different event, and retain the unrelated older contract separately. The 10 September question is within the stated 30-day window without adjudicating the exact terminal-day boundary. State source-listed refund deduction categories and the non-revival/fresh-proposal condition, but withhold an exact refund, cancellation completion or replacement acceptance. Do not infer life eligibility, transfer the spouse into the life policy, or expose any other customer’s contracts.
acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent conditional explanation with exact citations, explicit whole-combi consequences and missing refund/underwriting inputs.
A focused request for real schedules and insurer receipt proof before operational guidance, while still explaining the supported coupled-cancellation clause.

evidence.section: Combi identity and distinct policy benefits
evidence.exact_passage:
Health Maximiser
Dear Sir/ Madam,
We welcome you to the Zurich Kotak family. We are glad to inform you that your proposal has been accepted and
Health Maximiser (UIN: ZUKHLIP25057V022425) ("Combi Product") has been issued to you. The Combi Product
is jointly issued by Zurich Kotak General Insurance Company (India) Limited and Kotak Mahindra Life Insurance
Company Limited ("KLI"); wherein Health Premier (UIN: ZUKHLIP25054V052425) is issued by Zurich Kotak
General Insurance Company (India) Limited and Kotak Term Plan (UIN: 107N005V06) is issued by KLI.
The benefits under the two policies of this Combi Product are distinct as per the respective policies as offered by
the respective insurers.
evidence.reading_method: Native text from declared original page crop, checked against rendered physical page 1.

evidence.section: Complete free-look paragraph including coupled cancellation and non-revival
evidence.exact_passage:
Free-look Period:
In case you are not agreeable to any of the provisions stated in the Combi Product, then you have the option of
returning the Combi Product to us stating the reasons thereof within 30 days from the date of the receipt of the
Combi Product. The cancellation request should be submitted to your nearest branch or sent directly to the Head
Office of any of the Insurers. On receipt of your letter along with the original policy documents, we shall arrange
to refund the premium paid by you after deducting expenses on medical examination and the stamp duty
charges; and the proportionate risk premium for period on cover. A Combi Product once returned shall not be
revived, reinstated or restored at any point of time and a new proposal will have to be made for the issue of a new
Combi Product.
For the policy issued by Zurich Kotak General Insurance Company (India) Limited, the Free-look cancellation
option is not available at the time of its renewal. You shall not be allowed to cancel the policies individually during
the Free-look Period. An application for cancellation of either of the policies during the Free-look Period will
cancel this Combi Product in its entirety.
